#Installing packages and loading libraries
```{r}
#install.packages("deSolve")
#install.packages("FME")
#install.packages("DEoptim")
library(tidyverse)
library(phyloseq)
library(FME)
library(deSolve)
library(DEoptim)
```

#Reading phyloseq
```{r}
### ============================================================
### 1. Load + preprocess data
### ============================================================

# Read phyloseq object
ps.cln <- readRDS("/Users/aryagautam/Desktop/Academics/Fall 2025/Calculating Biological Quantites/metaphlan.combinedb1b2b3.infants.rds")

ps.melt <- psmelt(ps.cln)

retain <- c("Bifidobacterium_longum",
            "Bifidobacterium_breve",
            "Bifidobacterium_bifidum")

ps.melt <- ps.melt %>% filter(Species %in% retain)

# Fix timepoints
tp_map <- c(`1`=0.5, `2`=1, `3`=1.5, `4`=2, `5`=2.5, `6`=3,
            `8`=9, `9`=6, `12`=9, `15`=12)

ps.melt$TIMEPOINT <- recode(as.character(ps.melt$TIMEPOINT), !!!tp_map) %>% as.numeric()

# Average by lifestyle
ps.melt2 <- aggregate(Abundance ~ LIFESTYLE + Species + TIMEPOINT, 
                      data = ps.melt, mean)

# choose lifestyle
obs_raw <- ps.melt2 %>% filter(LIFESTYLE == "Urban")

obs <- obs_raw %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Species, values_from = Abundance) %>%
  arrange(TIMEPOINT)

obs <- obs %>%
  rename(N1 = Bifidobacterium_longum,
         N2 = Bifidobacterium_bifidum,
         N3 = Bifidobacterium_breve)

```

#ODE Solver
```{r}
### ============================================================
### 3.  Set abundances
### ============================================================
times <- obs$TIMEPOINT
state0 <- c(N1 = obs$N1[1],
            N2 = obs$N2[1],
            N3 = obs$N3[1])

### ============================================================
### 4.  Define gLV model
### ============================================================
gLV <- function(t, state, pars) {
  p <- as.list(pars)
  with(as.list(c(state, p)), {
    # Positivity floor
    N1 <- max(N1, 1e-8)
    N2 <- max(N2, 1e-8)
    N3 <- max(N3, 1e-8)
    
    # Logistic + interactions
    dN1 <- N1 * (r1 * (1 - N1 / K1) + a12 * N2 + a13 * N3)
    dN2 <- N2 * (r2 * (1 - N2 / K2) + a21 * N1 + a23 * N3)
    dN3 <- N3 * (r3 * (1 - N3 / K3) + a31 * N1 + a32 * N2)
    
    list(c(dN1, dN2, dN3))
  })
}
### ============================================================
### 5. Optimization function 
### ============================================================
objective_log <- function(par, times, obs, state0) {
  names(par) <- names(params_init)
  
  # Try lsoda first
  out <- try(
    ode(y = state0, times = times, func = gLV, parms = par,
        method = "lsoda", atol = 1e-8, rtol = 1e-8, maxsteps = 1e6),
    silent = TRUE
  )
  
  # If lsoda fails, try radau (stiff solver)
  if (inherits(out, "try-error") || nrow(out) != length(times)) {
    out <- try(
      ode(y = state0, times = times, func = gLV, parms = par,
          method = "radau", atol = 1e-8, rtol = 1e-8),
      silent = TRUE
    )
  }
  
  # If still failing, return huge penalty
  if (inherits(out, "try-error") || nrow(out) != length(times)) {
    return(1e12)
  }
  
  # Extract predictions
  pred <- out[, c("N1", "N2", "N3"), drop = FALSE]
  obs_matrix <- as.matrix(obs[, c("N1", "N2", "N3")])
  
  # Check for unrealistic values
  if (any(pred < 0) || any(pred > 500) || any(!is.finite(pred))) {
    return(1e12)
  }
  
  # Log-scale error (weights small and large populations equally)
  epsilon <- 0.01
  log_pred <- log(pred + epsilon)
  log_obs <- log(obs_matrix + epsilon)
  
  if (any(!is.finite(log_pred)) || any(!is.finite(log_obs))) {
    return(1e12)
  }
  
  sse_log <- sum((log_pred - log_obs)^2)
  
  return(if (is.finite(sse_log)) sse_log else 1e12)
}

### ============================================================
### 6. Parameter bounds + optimization
### ============================================================
params_init <- c(
  r1 = 0.8,   r2 = 0.2,   r3 = 0.2,     # N1 grows fast initially
  K1 = 80,    K2 = 12,    K3 = 8,       # Based on max observed
  a12 = -0.03, a13 = -0.03,             # N2, N3 suppress N1 weakly
  a21 = -0.08, a23 = 0.01,              # N1 suppresses N2 strongly
  a31 = -0.05, a32 = 0.01               # N1 suppresses N3 moderately
)

lower <- c(
  r1 = 0.1,   r2 = 0.01,  r3 = 0.01,
  K1 = 60,    K2 = 8,     K3 = 5,
  a12 = -0.2, a13 = -0.2,               # N1 can be suppressed
  a21 = -0.3, a23 = -0.1,               # N1 strongly suppresses others
  a31 = -0.3, a32 = -0.1
)

upper <- c(
  r1 = 2.0,   r2 = 0.5,   r3 = 0.5,
  K1 = 100,   K2 = 15,    K3 = 12,
  a12 = -0.001, a13 = -0.001,           # Weak suppression of N1
  a21 = -0.01,  a23 = 0.2,              # Weak suppression, slight facilitation
  a31 = -0.01,  a32 = 0.2
)

# Run DEoptim 
test_sse <- objective_log(params_init, times, obs, state0)

fit_de <- DEoptim(
  fn = objective_log,
  lower = lower,
  upper = upper,
  control = DEoptim.control(
  itermax = 400,
  trace = 25,
  NP = 150,
  CR = 0.9,
  F = 0.8,
  strategy = 3,           
  storepopfrom = 350      
  ),
  times = times,
  obs = obs,
  state0 = state0
)

final_par <- fit_de$optim$bestmem
names(final_par) <- names(params_init)

### ============================================================
### 7. Simulate using fitted parameters
### ============================================================
sim_times <- seq(0.5, 12, length.out = 200)
sim <- ode(
  y = state0,
  times = sim_times,
  func = gLV,
  parms = final_par,
  method = "lsoda"
)

sim_df <- as.data.frame(sim) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c("N1", "N2", "N3"), 
               names_to = "Species", 
               values_to = "Value")

obs_long <- obs %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c("N1", "N2", "N3"),
               names_to = "Species",
               values_to = "Value") %>%
  rename(time = TIMEPOINT)

### ============================================================
### 8. Plot
### ============================================================
ggplot() +
  geom_line(data = sim_df, aes(x = time, y = Value, color = Species), 
            linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_point(data = obs_long, aes(x = time, y = Value, color = Species), 
             size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_y_log10(labels = scales::comma) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(N1 = "#619CFF", N2 = "#F8766D", N3 = "#00BA38"),
    labels = c(N1 = "B. longum", N2 = "B. bifidum", N3 = "B. breve")
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  labs(
    title = "gLV Model Fit (Log Scale)",
    subtitle = paste("Log-SSE:", round(fit_de$optim$bestval, 2)),
    y = "Abundance (log scale)", 
    x = "Time"
  ) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

ggplot() +
  geom_line(data = sim_df, aes(x = time, y = Value, color = Species), 
            linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_point(data = obs_long, aes(x = time, y = Value, color = Species), 
             size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(N1 = "#619CFF", N2 = "#F8766D", N3 = "#00BA38"),
    labels = c(N1 = "B. longum", N2 = "B. bifidum", N3 = "B. breve")
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  labs(
    title = "gLV Model Fit (Linear Scale)",
    subtitle = paste("Log-SSE:", round(fit_de$optim$bestval, 2)),
    y = "Abundance", 
    x = "Time"
  ) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

sim_forward <- ode(
```

#Equilibria and stability
```{r}
#Define parameters
r1  <- final_par["r1"]
r2  <- final_par["r2"]
r3  <- final_par["r3"]

K1 <- final_par["K1"]
K2 <- final_par["K2"]
K3 <- final_par["K3"]

a12 <- final_par["a12"]
a13 <- final_par["a13"]
a21 <- final_par["a21"]

a23 <- final_par["a23"]
a31 <- final_par["a31"]
a32 <- final_par["a32"]

# -------------------------------------------
# 1. Solve interior equilibrium N*
# -------------------------------------------
M <- matrix(c(
  -r1/K1,   a12,     a13,
   a21,   -r2/K2,    a23,
   a31,     a32,   -r3/K3
), nrow=3, byrow=TRUE)

b <- -c(r1, r2, r3)

# Solve for equilibrium abundances
Neq <- solve(M, b)
Neq

# -------------------------------------------
# 2. Build Jacobian at equilibrium
# -------------------------------------------
N1 <- Neq[1]; N2 <- Neq[2]; N3 <- Neq[3]

J <- matrix(0, nrow = 3, ncol = 3)
# diag
J[1,1] <- r1*(1 - 2*N1/K1) + a12 * N2 + a13 * N3
J[2,2] <- r2*(1 - 2*N2/K2) + a21 * N1 + a23 * N3
J[3,3] <- r3*(1 - 2*N3/K3) + a31 * N1 + a32 * N2
# off-diagonals
J[1,2] <- a12 * N1
J[1,3] <- a13 * N1
J[2,1] <- a21 * N2
J[2,3] <- a23 * N2
J[3,1] <- a31 * N3
J[3,2] <- a32 * N3

# -------------------------------------------
# 3. Stability check
# -------------------------------------------
eigen(J)$values


```
